text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Today... no, you always have 
such great determination in your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
How are things? Are you running into any 
trouble? If it's about overseas 
expeditions—especially in Europe— don't 
hesitate to ask me anything.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the latest race trends, 
history, track conditions, strategy, or 
connections to insiders... you can rely on 
me for anything.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you all need to make your dreams 
come true... I will provide everything!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Hm, that bread from earlier... is this 
it? No... I just didn't have time to eat 
today."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! I'll eat plenty tomorrow! 
...Oh, yeah, if you want... you could even 
keep me company, you know?
